Watermark PDF

Brand or mark pages with tasteful watermarks.

Stamp text or an image across your pages with control over opacity, rotation, position and a tiled pattern. Perfect for drafts and confidential copies.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How Watermark PDF works

  1. Add a PDF and enter your watermark text or upload an image.
  2. Tune size, opacity, angle, color and position.
  3. Apply and download the watermarked file.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.
